summary: A single initial access broker operator used the ProjectDiscovery Nuclei scanner at industrial scale from two CTG Server Limited (AS152194) IPs over December 25-28, testing 240+ exploits and confirming hits via Interactsh out-of-band (OAST) callback domains. GreyNoise attributes 57,000+ unique OAST subdomains and a shared Machine ID/JA4 fingerprint across 98% of attempts to one operator, indicating harvested vulnerability inventory destined for ransomware affiliates. Detection should focus on DNS/sinkhole logs for oast.* callback lookups and network logs for the two scanning IPs.
